pool_note: 60 runs: 20 real ATL arrivals from DOT 2015 x 3 condition sets, pool seed 42, claude-haiku-5-5 agents

baselines.name: First come, first served (no gate coordination)

estimated.name: Time to decide
estimated.value: 5.5 s per negotiation vs 10 to 15 min of phone calls

failure_case.summary: DL1710 (fog + one runway closed + gates tight + shift ending): costliest outcome, 117 min late, even the optimum could not do better
failure_case.what_happened: Concord and the omniscient optimiser picked the same plan (cost 130): 117 min late, 0 missed connections, 25 min ramp overtime.
failure_case.why: The conditions left only expensive legal slots. Negotiation cannot create runway capacity or gates that do not exist.
failure_case.fix: Add diversion airports and later slots as candidates, and let the Pilot desk weigh a diversion against a long hold.
